data.rationale: The proposal matches the true search flow (origin, destination, dates, passengers, promo, Search) in the right order with the right parameters, but it leaves out the flight and fare selection and the optional passenger details/booking steps, and it adds trip-type and passenger-count steps that the true actions don't show; the concrete UI steps are still enough to automate.
